title: Operator profile for OODA-loop intake
description: Portable, non-secret context claims and constraints for ooda-loop. A profile never grants authority: execution requires independent repository, user and live-host evidence, and immutable policy may only be tightened.

source_kind.description: Origin of the claims, not an authorization channel.

expires_at.description: Runtime must park an expired profile; schema validation alone does not prove freshness.

source_digest.description: Optional digest of the separately retained source record; never a secret or credential.

role.description: Business role, never a real name or account identifier.

technical_literacy.description: Changes explanation style only; it does not constrain delegated technical decisions.

language.description: BCP 47-style language tag for a necessary business-facing question, for example pt-BR.

authority.description: Non-authorizing claims and additional constraints. Effective execution authority is proved elsewhere.

technical_delegation_claim.description: Preference/claim only. It may route technical questions away from the operator after an independent grant is proved, but cannot authorize an action.

baseline_acknowledgements.description: Acknowledges the immutable generic deny baseline; enforcement comes from policy, never this array. Project/live policy may add gates and the profile may not remove one.

authoritative.description: Declared context lookup order. The runtime must independently verify each cited source before treating it as evidence.

candidate_stages.description: Requested routing candidates, not permissions. Evidence and live gates select the next stage.

deploy_mode.description: Gated means a real deployment still needs the target environment's live technical controls; it is never inferred from this file.
